scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/browser packages/node packages/react packages/next packages/openfeature
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/core/dist packages/core/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo packages/browser/dist packages/browser/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo packages/node/dist packages/node/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo packages/react/dist packages/react/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo packages/next/dist packages/next/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo packages/openfeature/dist packages/openfeature/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm run test:built
scripts.test:built: node --test packages/core/test/*.test.mjs packages/browser/test/*.test.mjs packages/node/test/*.test.mjs packages/react/test/*.test.mjs packages/next/test/*.test.mjs packages/openfeature/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/browser packages/node packages/react packages/next packages/openfeature --pretty false
